purpose: Frozen, language-neutral rules for reconciling Semantic Compression support annotations before the blinded comparability audit.

authoritative_support_record.rule: When a cohort adjudication or comparability repair exists for a sampled (probe, language) pair, that complete record is the sole support source for the comparability sample. Stale support-level prose from single-language metric shards is discarded rather than treated as a second vote.

partial.partial_reasons: one or more of P-a, P-b, P-c, P-d, P-e

none.none_reason: exactly one of N-1, N-2, N-3, N-4

symmetry_rules.rule: A documented module or facility shipped in the frozen language distribution is not disqualified merely because it is a library wrapper rather than syntax. Whether it earns FULL, PARTIAL or NONE is decided only by the numbered canonical_task sub-requirements and the frozen support rubric.

If the same documented standard mechanism is credited as delivering at least one numbered sub-requirement on one sampled probe, another sampled probe may classify it as NONE only when that probe's numbered requirements make the mechanism deliver none of them. The justification must name that observable distinction.
Every PARTIAL record must name the applicable frozen P-letter(s). A PARTIAL without a P-letter is incomplete evidence, not a comparable annotation.
Every NONE record must name one frozen N-reason and cite the language rule or observed build/run evidence that makes the capability unavailable.
Determinacy, locality and other OBSERVATION TARGET text never changes FULL/PARTIAL/NONE. Those facts belong to their own Semantic Compression metrics.

For FFI probes, distinguish a language/toolchain's documented built-in interoperability facility from a third-party package, binding generator or separate build system. A built-in facility that misses a numbered requirement may be PARTIAL with the matching P-letter; absence of any built-in facility satisfying a numbered requirement is NONE with the matching N-reason.

repair_loop.rule: A failed blinded comparability audit may propose complete support-record repairs for only the disputed sampled pairs. The runner applies changed repairs, rebuilds the blinded sample and reruns the same audit. If no directive changes the canonical record, the gate remains failed and no further paid retry is made.
repair_loop.anti_gaming: Repairs are limited to the predeclared sampled annotations and frozen rubric; rankings and aggregate scores are unavailable to the repair decision.
